scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Hm...?
Oh, welcome to
the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Did you
need something?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
嗯...？
啊，歡迎光臨卡普拉總公司。
請問有什麼需要嗎？

scripts.text: Save
scripts.translation: 儲存

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用倉庫

scripts.text: Rent a Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租用手推車

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Your Respawn Point has
been saved here, inside
of the Kafra Corporation
Headquarters. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
您的復活點已儲存在卡普拉總公司內。
謝謝。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Please make use of
the Kafra Services that are
available throughout all of
Midgard. Thank you for
visiting the Kafra Headquarters.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
請善用遍佈米德加爾特的卡普拉服務。
感謝光臨卡普拉總公司。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Excuse me, but it
seems that you don't
have the 20 zeny to pay
the Storage access fee...
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
抱歉，您似乎沒有20 Zeny來支付倉庫使用費...

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Although this facility is
exclusively intended for
the training of Kafra Employee
and administrative functions,
I'll access your Storage for you.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
這裡專門用於卡普拉職員培訓和行政事務，不過，我還是為您開啟倉庫吧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
In the future, please
ask the Kafra Employee on
duty if you wish to use
any of the Kafra Services.
Thank you for your patronage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
以後需要卡普拉服務，請找正在值班的職員。
感謝您的惠顧。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
My apologies, but I'm
not on duty. I'd assist you
if I could, but actually don't
have any available Pushcarts.
Why don't you ask another Kafra
Employee for assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
抱歉，我現在不當班。
雖然很想幫您，但手頭沒有可供租用的手推車。
不妨找其他卡普拉職員問問？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
Kafra Employees are
stationed all over the
Midgard continent,
and you should be able to find
plenty outside in Al De Baran.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
卡普拉職員遍佈米德加爾特大陸，外面的艾爾帕蘭城裡就有不少。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Leilah]
^666666*Whew...*^000000
Great, because I'm
actually on my break
right now. Choosing
''Cancel'' was a good
move on your part.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 萊拉]
^666666*Whew...*^000000
太好了，我現在其實正在休息。
您選擇“取消”，真是幫了我大忙。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
The Kafra Corporation
is always working to provide
you with convenient services.
How may I be of assistance?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
卡普拉公司始終致力於為您提供便捷的服務。
請問有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome~!
The Kafra Services
are always on your side.
So how can I help you?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎~！
卡普拉服務永遠在您身邊。
請問有什麼可以幫您？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome!
The Kafra Corporation
will always support the
adventurers of Rune-Midgarts
with its excellent service. So
what can I do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉 職員]
歡迎光臨！
卡普拉公司將始終以優質服務，支援盧恩·米德加茲的冒險者。
今天有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
